rules: Death report validates unresolved sow litters for every actual pig before applying any row. SDL lacks is_exported, so no default is guessed.
Death membership includes PLANNED/SCHEDULED/RUNNING across batches; actual per-type query returns first row without order, so multiple matches cannot be selected deterministically.
Maternal death side effects reduce all related lactation/farrowing/piglet handling litters; first matching identity by nonempty tag OR notch is removed, anonymous count clamps at zero.
Known absent actual pig and repeated DEAD pig are skipped; mother reference is modified litter owner, never a death target.
Actual death writes truthy location_code; full location relation awaits a read if changed.
Unexposed death mortality/export flags and server-generated image metadata, ids and timestamps remain pending.
